title: 第1164章 孔玄 你自己有问题第1163章 圣人学府
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
空旷的儒圣殿内，悄无声息，被儒圣和七十二贤的塑像紧紧盯着，即便是阴无极都感觉有些不舒服。
此刻不止儒圣殿，哪怕圣人学府都寂静无声。
只因儒门浩然派也在举行选拔。
而且和古佛寺的三千菩提世界一样，儒门的七十二贤，三千门徒，都在异空间进行选拔。
本来平时整个圣人学府，以及周边各种大大小小的学府，哪怕没有靠近，都能听到各种朗朗上口的读书声。
普通人听后心神震荡，会不由自主跟着读，从而陷入进去，成为贡献儒门香火之力的一份子。
“原来是陛下驾到！”
“儒门孔玄，参见陛下！”
一道爽朗的轻喝声从儒圣殿内不知何处传来，声音反弹的回音回荡在整个殿内。
阴无极眉头一皱，立刻护至殷辛身前。
虽然知道儒门的儒圣孔玄，前不久主动投诚了陛下。
但对于孔玄，他还是抱有警惕之心。
因为投诚的太过干脆，说不定内有乾坤。
“阴大人，你这么做，是不是有些不信任本夫子了！”
一道青衫人影显现，随即轻笑出声，语气中暗含对阴无极的鄙夷。
只见这青衫之人，竟然是个一米八的绝色青年。
大部分长发上盘束冠，多余散碎的长发随风飘逸，白面嫩肤，相貌俊朗无比，看起来就和女人一样。
甚至比殷辛还年轻。
手里更是拿着一本破古书，嘴角挂着淡淡的微笑，一副对世间不羁放纵的态度。
阴无极眉头一挑，立刻看向了儒圣的塑像。

只见这塑像明明是个一脸严肃的微胖花甲老夫子，正盘膝而坐，手持一册竹简，双目深邃看着前方。
和此刻挂着淡淡微笑的孔玄的形象，大相径庭。
这要是说出去，这绝色青年就是活了十万年，一手创立儒门的儒圣，恐怕没人会相信。
“无极！”殷辛见阴无极这番样子，立刻喝退他。
阴无极带着凝重神色后退，依然警惕看着孔玄。
孔玄倒是没有理会他，而是收起笑容，一脸郑重上前。
随意拿着古书微微颔首道：“孔玄，见过陛下！”
和饿死诡跪拜殷辛，以及尹衡和仟夭躬身不同。
孔玄压根腰都没折一下，仿佛把殷辛当平等地位的对象来对待。
就像是朋友见朋友那样，不为五斗米而折腰。
看的阴无极一阵火大。
他本身就对朝堂上的一些酸臭腐儒没好感。
更别说孔玄了，哪怕你是儒圣我也瞧不上你。
殷辛轻笑道：“孔玄，选拔已经开始，等五日之后的论道开始，你可不能给朕掉链子，在背后捅朕一刀！”
孔玄语气平淡道：“陛下这是在警告我不要反水当墙头草吗。”
“可知君子喻于义，小人喻于利，我只是为了天下的太平，以及我儒门的稳定而着想。”
“十万年来，再也没有任何利益能让本圣在意，即便四大圣地能掌控西大陆又如何，只会让天下陷入死地，众生陷入迷信，唯有盛世太平才能让我感兴趣。”
孔玄这么说，其实就是因为儒门和大殷捆绑的太深。
儒门的学子，不止修炼武道强身。
content_en:
There was no sound in the empty Confucian Temple, and the statues of Confucian saints and seventy-two sages stared closely at him. Even Yin Wuji felt a little uncomfortable.
At this moment, not only the Confucian Temple, but also the Sage Academy were silent.
Just because the Confucian Haoran Sect is also holding a selection.
And just like the Three Thousand Bodhi World in the ancient Buddhist temple, the seventy-two sages and three thousand disciples of the Confucian sect are all selected in different dimensions.
Normally, all kinds of catchy reading sounds can be heard in the entire Sage Academy, as well as various large and small schools in the surrounding area, even if they are not close.
Ordinary people will be shocked after listening to it, and they will read it involuntarily, fall into it, and become a part of the contribution to the incense of Confucianism.
"It turns out that His Majesty has arrived!"
"Kong Xuan, a Confucian scholar, comes to see Your Majesty!"
A hearty shout came from somewhere in the Confucian Temple, and the echo of the sound echoed throughout the hall.
Yin Wuji frowned and immediately protected Yin Xin.
Although I know that Kong Xuan, the Confucian sage of the Confucian sect, recently surrendered to His Majesty.
But he was still wary of Kong Xuan.
Because the surrender was too simple, there might be something wrong with it.
"Master Yin, by doing this, you don't trust me a little!"
A figure in a green shirt appeared, and then chuckled, his tone implying contempt for Yin Wuji.
I saw that the man in green shirt turned out to be a stunning young man with a height of 1.8 meters.
Most of the long hair is tied up in a crown, and the extra long hair is flowing in the wind. The face is fair and tender, and the appearance is extremely handsome. She looks just like a woman.
Even younger than Yin Xin.
He was holding a tattered ancient book in his hand, with a faint smile on his lips, and an uninhibited and indulgent attitude towards the world.
Yin Wuji raised his eyebrows and immediately looked at the statue of the Confucian sage.
I saw that this statue was obviously a fat old man in sixties with a serious face, sitting cross-legged, holding a bamboo slip, and looking deeply ahead.
It was very different from the image of Kong Xuan who was wearing a faint smile at the moment.
If it were revealed that this stunning young man was a Confucian sage who had lived for a hundred thousand years and founded the Confucian sect, no one would believe it.
"Wuji!" Yin Xin saw Yin Wuji's appearance and immediately shouted him back.
Yin Wuji backed away with a solemn expression, still looking at Kong Xuan warily.
Kong Xuan ignored him, but put away his smile and stepped forward with a solemn expression.
Holding the ancient book casually, he nodded slightly and said, "Kong Xuan, I have met His Majesty!"
It is different from the starving Gui who knelt down to worship Yin Xin, and Yin Heng and Qian Yao who bowed down.
Kong Xuan didn't bend at all, as if he treated Yin Xin as an equal.
Just like a friend meeting a friend, don't bend your waist for five buckets of rice.
Looking at it, Yin Wuji felt furious.
He himself did not like some of the sour and rotten scholars in the court.
Not to mention Kong Xuan, even if you are a Confucian sage, I still look down on you.
Yin Xin chuckled and said: "Kong Xuan, the selection has begun. When the discussion begins in five days, you can't let me off the hook and stab me in the back!"
Kong Xuan said in a calm tone: "Your Majesty, are you warning me not to rebel and become a wallflower?"
"It can be seen that a gentleman is known as righteousness, and a villain is known as benefit. I only think about the peace of the world and the stability of my Confucian sect."
"In the past hundred thousand years, there has been no benefit that I care about. Even if the Four Holy Lands can control the Western Continent, so what, it will only plunge the world into death and all living beings into superstition. Only prosperity and peace can interest me."
Kong Xuan said this because the Confucian sect and Da Yin were tied too deeply.
Confucian students not only practice martial arts to strengthen their bodies.
